This is a feature request, so it needs approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before it can be considered as an issue. Please open a discussion describing the use case.

Rich has no column that shows speed with a custom unit. [`TaskProgressColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) only shows speed when `total` is unknown, and always as `it/s`. In the meantime, a small subclass of [`ProgressColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) can render `task.finished_speed or task.speed` with your own unit. Related earlier discussion is in #3835.
